summary: E2E frontend verification of iter236 'Recogida en tienda física'. All critical flows PASS: (1) admin CRUD de Tiendas (create/list/edit/delete) in Inventario, (2) VIP marketplace pickup UI (fulfillment-pickup-btn, pickup-store-picker, hides redeem-addr, shows redeem-pickup-free-line), (3) validation toast when confirming pickup with 2+ stores and none selected, (4) VIP pickup redeem without address succeeds and shows 'Recogida en tienda · E2E236-A' in Mis canjes with NO courier fee, (5) Admin /admin/withdrawals shows purple pickup badge with store name+address and courier column shows 'Recogida en tienda' instead of km editor, (6) 'Listo p/ recoger' button clickable — replaced by 'Cliente avisado' + idempotent after reload; pickup_ready notification created for VIP and VIP dashboard shows 'Listo para recoger' badge, (7) delivery-flow regression (dirección textarea + confirm) still works, (8) AdminProducts edit dialog shows prod-stores-availability block with prod-store-check-{storeId} checkboxes; limiting product to Store A hides Store B in VIP checkout pickup selector.

issues: Multiple DialogContent components emit React warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` (accessibility). Non-blocking but should be addressed.

Console: 'Encountered two children with the same key, TEST_X' — duplicate React keys in admin products list (likely from seeded TEST_* products with same generated key). Non-blocking cosmetic warning.

action_items: (Low) Add aria-describedby/DialogDescription to DialogContent instances in InventoryStoresTab and AdminProducts to silence Radix a11y warning.
(Low) Fix duplicate React key 'TEST_X' warning in Admin products listing (use unique product.id as key).
critical_code_review_comments: RedemptionsTable.jsx pickup-ready-btn is only rendered while status is pending/approved AND !pickup_ready_at — correct guard for idempotency in UI; server also idempotent per playbook.
MarketplaceView.jsx correctly hides redeem-addr and courier selector when fulfillment==='pickup' and validates store selection client-side before POST /api/vip/redeem.
InventoryStoresTab.jsx uses window.confirm for delete — acceptable but not accessible; consider AlertDialog for consistency.
AdminProducts prod-stores-availability block only shows when >=2 stores exist — behavior matches spec; note that with 0 stores registered no block is shown (verified: hidden in DB with 0 stores).
test_credentials: admin session_token=test_session_admin_X (user_test_admin01), vip session_token=test_session_vip_X (user_test_vip01, vip_balances.USD=5000, USDT=5000 set before run).

All test data (stores, notifications, redemption with store_id, and product.available_store_ids reset) cleaned up post-test.
